SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT clients_client.id) AS "Number of Clients"
FROM clients_client
INNER JOIN clients_site ON clients_site.client_id = clients_client.id
WHERE 
  clients_site.name IN ($Sites)
  AND clients_client.name IN ($Client);

SELECT
  count(*)
FROM agents_agent
where 
  site_id IN (SELECT id FROM clients_site WHERE site_id IN (SELECT id FROM clients_site WHERE name IN ($Sites))) and
  site_id IN (SELECT id FROM clients_site WHERE client_id IN (SELECT id FROM clients_client WHERE name IN ($Client)))
ORDER BY 1

SELECT CONCAT(
  (SELECT
    count(*)
  FROM
    alerts_alert
    LEFT JOIN checks_check on alerts_alert.assigned_check_id = checks_check.id
    LEFT JOIN autotasks_automatedtask on alerts_alert.assigned_task_id = autotasks_automatedtask.id
    INNER JOIN agents_agent ON autotasks_automatedtask.agent_id = agents_agent.id
    OR checks_check.agent_id = agents_agent.id
    OR alerts_alert.agent_id = agents_agent.id
    INNER JOIN clients_site ON agents_agent.site_id = clients_site.id
    INNER JOIN clients_client ON clients_site.client_id = clients_client.id
  WHERE
    clients_client.name IN ($Client)
    AND clients_site.name IN ($Sites)
    AND alerts_alert.severity = 'info'
    AND alerts_alert.resolved = false
  ),
  ' / ',
  (SELECT
    count(*)
  FROM
    alerts_alert
  WHERE
    alerts_alert.severity = 'info'
    AND alerts_alert.resolved = false
  )
)

SELECT 
  clients_client.name AS "Client",  -- Nom du client ajouté en première colonne
  clients_site.name AS "Site",
  
  -- Logo en fonction de l'Operating System et des versions spécifiques de Windows
  CASE
      WHEN agents_agent.operating_system ILIKE '%Windows 11%' THEN 'https://img.icons8.com/color/512/windows-11.png'
      WHEN agents_agent.operating_system ILIKE '%Windows 10%' THEN 'https://img.icons8.com/color/512/windows-10.png'
      WHEN agents_agent.operating_system ILIKE '%Windows 7%' THEN 'https://img.icons8.com/color/512/windows-7.png'
      WHEN agents_agent.operating_system ILIKE '%Windows Server%' THEN 'https://img.icons8.com/?size=100&id=cqhNzxHz0MMy&format=png&color=000000'
      WHEN agents_agent.operating_system ILIKE '%macOS%' THEN 'https://img.icons8.com/color/512/mac-os.png'
      WHEN agents_agent.operating_system ILIKE '%Debian%' THEN 'https://img.icons8.com/color/512/debian.png'
      WHEN agents_agent.operating_system ILIKE '%Ubuntu%' THEN 'https://img.icons8.com/color/512/ubuntu.png'
      ELSE 'https://example.com/unknown-os-logo.png'
  END AS "OS",  -- Logo basé sur l'OS

  -- Logo pour Server / Workstation
  CASE
      WHEN agents_agent.monitoring_type ILIKE '%server%' THEN 'https://img.papamica.com/icon/server.png'
      ELSE 'https://cdn-icons-png.flaticon.com/512/4703/4703644.png'
  END AS "Type",  -- Logo basé sur le type (Server ou Workstation)

  agents_agent.hostname AS "Hostname",
  agents_agent.id AS "AgentID",

  -- Lien de connexion (string_value du field_id = 4)
  COALESCE((
      SELECT 
          string_value 
      FROM agents_agentcustomfield 
      WHERE agent_id = agents_agent.id 
      AND field_id = 4
  ), 'No Link') AS "connect_url",  -- Récupère le lien de connexion du champ personnalisé
  'https://cdn-icons-png.flaticon.com/128/10337/10337331.png' as "🔗",
  'https://genevois-informatique.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/cropped-logo-01-cb-1.png' as "RMM",
  'https://grafana.com/static/assets/img/fav32.png' as "Stats",
  
  -- Status: Online/Offline basé sur la dernière vue
  (
        CASE
            WHEN last_seen > NOW() - interval '1 minute' THEN 'Online'
            ELSE 'Offline'
        END
    ) AS "Status",
  
  -- Statut combiné Bitdefender et antivirus Windows : OK si l'un des deux est OK, sinon ERROR, OK par défaut si OS n'est pas Windows
  CASE
      WHEN agents_agent.operating_system NOT ILIKE '%Windows%' THEN 'OK'
      WHEN EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 
          FROM checks_checkresult 
          WHERE agent_id = agents_agent.id 
          AND assigned_check_id IN (21, 33) 
          AND retcode = 0
      ) THEN 'OK'
      ELSE 'ERROR'
  END AS "Antivirus",

  -- Statut combiné pour Acronis et backup test (Check ID 22 et 35)
  CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM checks_checkresult
          WHERE agent_id = agents_agent.id
          AND assigned_check_id IN (22, 35)
          AND retcode = 3
      ) THEN 'NO'
      WHEN EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM checks_checkresult
          WHERE agent_id = agents_agent.id
          AND assigned_check_id IN (22, 35)
          AND retcode = 0
      ) THEN 'OK'
      ELSE 'ERROR'
  END AS "Backup",

  -- Colonne Update (mises à jour en attente)
  COALESCE((
      SELECT
          CASE 
              WHEN EXISTS 
              (
                  SELECT * 
                  FROM public.winupdate_winupdate 
                  WHERE action = 'approve' 
                  AND installed = 'False' 
                  AND agent_id = agents_agent.id
              )
              THEN 'WARNING'
              ELSE ''
          END
  ), '') AS "Update",

  -- Reboot en attente (basé sur le champ `needs_reboot`)
  CASE
    WHEN agents_agent.needs_reboot = true THEN 'WARNING'
  END AS "Reboot",

  -- Last Response en format relatif déplacé à la fin
  CASE
      WHEN age(NOW(), last_seen) < interval '1 minute' THEN 'Just now'
      WHEN age(NOW(), last_seen) < interval '1 hour' THEN concat(extract(minute from age(NOW(), last_seen)), ' minutes ago')
      WHEN age(NOW(), last_seen) < interval '1 day' THEN concat(extract(hour from age(NOW(), last_seen)), ' hours ago')
      ELSE concat(extract(day from age(NOW(), last_seen)), ' days ago')
  END AS "Last Response",
  
  -- Last Reboot en format relatif déplacé à la fin
  CASE
      WHEN age(NOW(), to_timestamp(boot_time)) < interval '1 minute' THEN 'Just now'
      WHEN age(NOW(), to_timestamp(boot_time)) < interval '1 hour' THEN concat(extract(minute from age(NOW(), to_timestamp(boot_time))), ' minutes ago')
      WHEN age(NOW(), to_timestamp(boot_time)) < interval '1 day' THEN concat(extract(hour from age(NOW(), to_timestamp(boot_time))), ' hours ago')
      ELSE concat(extract(day from age(NOW(), to_timestamp(boot_time))), ' days ago')
  END AS "Last Reboot"

FROM agents_agent
    INNER JOIN clients_site ON agents_agent.site_id = clients_site.id
    INNER JOIN clients_client ON clients_site.client_id = clients_client.id
WHERE
    clients_client.name IN ($Client)
    AND clients_site.name IN ($Sites);

SELECT 
    -- Date en format relatif
    CASE
        WHEN age(NOW(), alerts_alert.alert_time) < interval '1 minute' THEN 'Just now'
        WHEN age(NOW(), alerts_alert.alert_time) < interval '1 hour' THEN concat(extract(minute from age(NOW(), alerts_alert.alert_time)), ' minutes ago')
        WHEN age(NOW(), alerts_alert.alert_time) < interval '1 day' THEN concat(extract(hour from age(NOW(), alerts_alert.alert_time)), ' hours ago')
        ELSE concat(extract(day from age(NOW(), alerts_alert.alert_time)), ' days ago')
    END AS "Date",

    alerts_alert.message AS "Message",
    agents_agent.agent_id,
    'https://genevois-informatique.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/cropped-logo-01-cb-1.png' AS "RMM"
FROM alerts_alert
    LEFT JOIN checks_check ON alerts_alert.assigned_check_id = checks_check.id
    LEFT JOIN autotasks_automatedtask ON alerts_alert.assigned_task_id = autotasks_automatedtask.id
    INNER JOIN agents_agent ON autotasks_automatedtask.agent_id = agents_agent.id
                            OR checks_check.agent_id = agents_agent.id
                            OR alerts_alert.agent_id = agents_agent.id
    INNER JOIN clients_site ON agents_agent.site_id = clients_site.id
    INNER JOIN clients_client ON clients_site.client_id = clients_client.id
WHERE
  clients_client.name IN ($Client)
  AND clients_site.name IN ($Sites)
  AND alerts_alert.severity = 'error' 
  AND alerts_alert.resolved = false;

SELECT 
  count(*) as "count",
  SUBSTRING(agents_agent.operating_system,'(.*)(?:,|x86_64)') AS "Operating System"
FROM agents_agent
  INNER JOIN clients_site ON agents_agent.site_id = clients_site.id
  INNER JOIN clients_client ON clients_site.client_id = clients_client.id
WHERE
  clients_client.name IN ($Client)
  AND clients_site.name IN ($Sites)
Group by "Operating System"
Order by "count" desc

select (
SELECT
  count(*)
  FROM agents_agent
Where
  SUBSTRING(agents_agent.operating_system,POSITION(',' in agents_agent.operating_system)+2,2) = '64' and
  site_id IN (SELECT id FROM clients_site WHERE site_id IN (SELECT id FROM clients_site WHERE name IN ($Sites))) and
  site_id IN (SELECT id FROM clients_site WHERE client_id IN (SELECT id FROM clients_client WHERE name IN ($Client)))) as "64 Bit",

  (SELECT
  count(*)
  FROM agents_agent
Where
  SUBSTRING(agents_agent.operating_system,POSITION(',' in agents_agent.operating_system)+2,2) = '32' and
   site_id IN (SELECT id FROM clients_site WHERE site_id IN (SELECT id FROM clients_site WHERE name IN ($Sites))) and
  site_id IN (SELECT id FROM clients_site WHERE client_id IN (SELECT id FROM clients_client WHERE name IN ($Client)))) as "32 Bit"

SELECT 
    count(*) as "count",
    (CASE 
      WHEN wmi_detail->'cpu' IS NOT NULL
      THEN SUBSTRING(agents_agent.wmi_detail->'cpu'->0->0->>'Name','(?:AMD|Intel\(R\)|Intel)(.*)(?:@|Processor|with)')
      ELSE SUBSTRING(agents_agent.wmi_detail->'cpus'->>0,'(?:AMD|Intel\(R\)|Intel)(.*)(?:@|Processor|with)')
    END) as "CPU Name"
FROM agents_agent
    INNER JOIN clients_site ON agents_agent.site_id = clients_site.id
    INNER JOIN clients_client ON clients_site.client_id = clients_client.id
WHERE
  clients_client.name IN ($Client)
  AND clients_site.name IN ($Sites)
Group by "CPU Name"
Order by "count" desc

SELECT 
  count(*) as "count",
  concat((total_ram),' GB') as "Size Memory"
  FROM agents_agent
INNER JOIN clients_site on site_id = clients_site.id
WHERE site_id IN (SELECT id FROM clients_site WHERE client_id IN (SELECT id FROM clients_client WHERE name IN ($Client)))
AND site_id IN (SELECT id FROM clients_site WHERE site_id IN (SELECT id FROM clients_site WHERE name IN ($Sites)))
Group by "Size Memory"
Order by "count" desc

SELECT 
  CONCAT('[', clients_client.name, '] - ', clients_site.name, ' - ', agents_agent.hostname, '  (', agents_agent.description,')')
FROM 
  agents_agent
LEFT OUTER JOIN clients_site ON agents_agent.site_id = clients_site.id
LEFT OUTER JOIN clients_client ON clients_site.client_id = clients_client.id
WHERE 
  agents_agent.hostname = '${Agent:raw}';

SELECT 
  concat(
          to_char(now() - to_timestamp(boot_time) ,'DD' ),' Days ', 
          to_char(now() - to_timestamp(boot_time),'HH24' ), ' Hours ',
          to_char(now() - to_timestamp(boot_time),'MI' ), ' Minutes '
        )
From 
  agents_agent
Where
  agents_agent.hostname = '${Agent:raw}'

select   
CASE
  WHEN (count(*) = 1) THEN 'Connected'
  WHEN (count(*) = 0) THEN 'Not Connected'
  ELSE ''
 END AS modifiedpvc
  
 from 
  agents_agent
 where 
   agents_agent.hostname = '${Agent:raw}'  and
   last_seen > NOW()- interval '1 hours'

FROM 
  checks_checkhistory
WHERE

  check_id IN (SELECT id FROM checks_check WHERE check_type='memory') AND agent_id=(SELECT agent_id FROM agents_agent where agents_agent.hostname = '${Agent:raw}')

    )
    THEN 'Windows not up to date'
    ELSE 'Windows up to date'

    WHEN wmi_detail->'cpu' IS NOT NULL

    ELSE concat(wmi_detail->'cpus'->>0)
  END
from

where 
   agents_agent.hostname = '${Agent:raw}'

select
  CASE
   WHEN (agents_agent.needs_reboot = true) THEN 'Reboot required'
    WHEN (agents_agent.needs_reboot = false) THEN 'No reboot required'
  ELSE 'nothing'
 END AS  Status
From 
  agents_agent
Where
  agents_agent.hostname = '${Agent:raw}'

select   
   concat((total_ram),'GB / ',concat(wmi_detail->'mem'->0->0->>'Speed','MHz'))
  
from 
  agents_agent
where 
  agents_agent.hostname = '${Agent:raw}'

SELECT
    CASE 
        WHEN retcode = 0 THEN 'OK'
        WHEN retcode = 1 THEN 'ERROR'
        WHEN retcode = 2 THEN 'WARNING'
        ELSE 'Check result not found'
    END AS Status,
    substring(stdout, 'Last scan: (\d{2}\.\d{2}\.\d{4} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})') AS LastScanDate
FROM checks_checkresult
WHERE assigned_check_id = 21
AND agent_id = (SELECT id FROM agents_agent WHERE agents_agent.hostname = '${Agent:raw}');

SELECT
  wmi_detail,
  CASE
    WHEN wmi_detail->'disk' IS NOT NULL
    THEN concat(
      wmi_detail->'disk'->0->0->>'Model', ' / ',  -- Modèle du disque (ex: SSD/HDD)
      round((wmi_detail->'disk'->0->0->>'Size')::bigint / (1024*1024*1024), 2), ' GB'  -- Taille du disque en GB
    )
    ELSE 'Disk information not available'
  END AS DiskInfo
FROM
  agents_agent
WHERE
  agents_agent.hostname = '${Agent:raw}';

SELECT
    CASE 
        WHEN retcode = 0 THEN 'OK'
        WHEN retcode = 1 THEN 'ERROR'
        WHEN retcode = 2 THEN 'WARNING'
        ELSE 'Check result not found'
    END AS Status,
    substring(stdout, 'Last backup date: (\d{2}\.\d{2}\.\d{4} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})') AS LastBackupDate
FROM checks_checkresult
WHERE assigned_check_id = 22
AND agent_id = (SELECT id FROM agents_agent WHERE agents_agent.hostname = '${Agent:raw}');
